catalog.summary: Conversational channel reads, scheduled engagement monitoring, draft reviews, approved comment replies and performance reports.

steps.title: YouTube goals and protections
steps.description: After activation, synchronize published comments and replies, check for changes every 15 minutes after each scan, send a daily change digest, and prepare weekly official-metric reports with suggestions in the setup conversation. You can pause work and change the report cadence to monthly. Reports preserve missing-data limitations and never authorize channel changes. Posting replies or uploading videos requires separate grants, consent and exact approval.

steps.title: Preview build: use test channels only
steps.description: Automatic cleanup of stored YouTube data is not complete. Use authorized test channels only until retention, browser acceptance and real-provider verification are complete. Do not connect a production channel to this preview.
